name: english-study-hub
description: Monorepo for English Study Hub (server: Express, client: React). Orchestrating dev, build, test, and e2e scripts.
author: Team Constellation

scripts.install: npm run -s install:server && npm run -s install:client
scripts.server:dev: cd server && cross-env NODE_ENV=development nodemon index.js --watch . --watch ../client/dist
scripts.client:dev: cd client && cross-env NODE_ENV=development npm run dev
scripts.build: npm run -s build:client && npm run -s build:server
scripts.build:server: sh -c "rm -rf server/static && mkdir -p server/static && if [ -d client/dist ]; then cp -r client/dist/* server/static/; elif [ -d client/build ]; then cp -r client/build/* server/static/; else echo 'No client build found to copy.'; fi"
scripts.test: npm run -s test:server && npm run -s test:client
scripts.e2e: sh -c "cross-env CI=true NODE_ENV=production node server/index.js >/dev/null 2>&1 & SERVER_PID=$!; sleep 1; npx playwright test --reporter=list || true; kill $SERVER_PID || true"
scripts.lint: npm run -s lint:server && npm run -s lint:client
scripts.lint:server: cd server && (npm run lint || echo 'No server linter configured')
scripts.lint:client: cd client && (npm run lint || echo 'No client linter configured')
scripts.clean: rimraf node_modules client/node_modules server/node_modules && rimraf artifacts && rimraf server/static
scripts.ci: npm ci && npm run -s build && npm run -s test && npm run -s e2e
scripts.lint:test:ci: npm run -s lint && npm run -s test --silent
